title: Ma Xing Shi Gan Decoction reduces influenza A virus nucleoprotein levels in association with modulation of lactate-HMGB1 lactylation and autophagosome accumulation.
authors: Ji, Yongkuan; Liu, Hui; Liu, Lina; Jiang, Lin; Bai, Chen; Sun, Futongyu; Zhang, Hanwen; Li, Shuxuan; Li, Hai; Liu, Tiegang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方对流感病毒核蛋白水平及代谢-自噬通路的调节，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Viral pneumonia (VP), particularly that induced by influenza A virus (IAV), remains a major global health challenge and a leading cause of acute respiratory infections. Ma Xing Shi Gan Decoction (MXSG), a classical traditional Chinese medicine formula recorded in the ancient text Treatise on Cold Damage, has been widely used for centuries in China to treat febrile respiratory diseases and pneumonia. However, the molecular basis underlying its therapeutic effects remains incompletely defined. This study provides experimental evidence linking MXSG to modulation of VP and host metabolic-autophagy pathways. AIM OF THE STUDY: To investigate whether MXSG is associated with reduced IAV nucleoprotein (NP) levels and concurrent modulation of key glycolytic enzymes, HMGB1 lactylation, and autophagosome accumulation. Buddleoside was evaluated as an exploratory constituent. METHODS: A mouse model of VP was established by intranasal inoculation with IAV, while A549 cells were infected with IAV for in vitro studies. In vivo effects on glycolysis and autophagy were evaluated by assessing lung inflammatory cytokines, viral NP levels, glycolytic enzymes, and autophagy markers. Oxamate and diphenyleneiodonium chloride (DPI) were used as tools to interfere with lactate production. UPLC-MS/MS and molecular docking were performed to identify potential pathway-relevant constituents. In vitro, validation included lactate supplementation, oxamate treatment, buddleoside exposure, and HMGB1 overexpression. RESULTS: In vivo, MXSG reduced IAV NP levels and alleviated lung inflammatory injury. MXSG treatment was associated with decreased expression of glycolysis-related enzymes, reduced lactate accumulation, lower HMGB1 lactylation levels, and reduced autophagosome accumulation. Under DPI-mediated lactate accumulation, the inhibitory effect of MXSG on autophagosome accumulation was partially attenuated. Docking analysis suggested potential interaction between buddleoside and LDHA. In vitro, MXSG modulated lactate levels, HMGB1 lactylation, and autophagy-related markers, accompanied by decreased NP levels. CONCLUSION: MXSG reducing NP levels is associated with modulation of expression levels of glycolytic enzymes and reduced lactate production, and was accompanied by decreases in HMGB1 lactylation with expression and HMGB1-associated autophagosome accumulation providing a potential metabolic basis for MXSG-associated regulation of autophagy-related processes. These findings suggest a possible association between metabolic-autophagy signaling and MXSG-associated reductions in viral NP levels, but remain correlative and require further validation.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：病毒性肺炎（VP），尤其是由甲型流感病毒（IAV）诱导的病毒性肺炎，仍然是全球重大健康挑战，也是急性呼吸道感染的主要原因。麻杏石甘汤（MXSG）是古代文献《伤寒论》中记载的经典中药方剂，数百年来在中国广泛用于治疗发热性呼吸系统疾病和肺炎。然而，其治疗作用背后的分子基础尚未完全明确。本研究提供了将MXSG与VP调节及宿主代谢-自噬通路联系起来的实验证据。研究目的：探讨MXSG是否与降低IAV核蛋白（NP）水平以及同时调节关键糖酵解酶、HMGB1乳酰化及自噬体积累相关。将蒙花苷作为探索性成分进行评估。方法：通过鼻内接种IAV建立VP小鼠模型，同时用IAV感染A549细胞进行体外研究。通过评估肺组织炎症细胞因子、病毒NP水平、糖酵解酶和自噬标志物，评价体内对糖酵解和自噬的影响。使用草氨酸盐和二苯基碘鎓氯化物（DPI）作为干扰乳酸产生的工具。采用UPLC-MS/MS和分子对接鉴定潜在的途径相关成分。体外验证包括乳酸补充、草氨酸盐处理、蒙花苷暴露及HMGB1过表达。结果：在体内，MXSG降低了IAV NP水平并减轻了肺组织炎症损伤。MXSG治疗与糖酵解相关酶表达降低、乳酸积累减少、HMGB1乳酰化水平降低及自噬体积累减少相关。在DPI介导的乳酸积累条件下，MXSG对自噬体积累的抑制作用部分减弱。对接分析提示蒙花苷与LDHA之间存在潜在相互作用。在体外，MXSG调节乳酸水平、HMGB1乳酰化及自噬相关标志物，并伴随NP水平降低。结论：MXSG降低NP水平与糖酵解酶表达水平调节及乳酸产生减少相关，并伴随HMGB1乳酰化及其表达降低，以及HMGB1相关自噬体积累减少，这为MXSG相关自噬过程调节提供了潜在代谢基础。这些发现提示代谢-自噬信号与MXSG相关病毒NP水平降低之间可能存在关联，但仍属相关性结果，需进一步验证。
